name: google-sheets
description: Google Sheets and Google Tasks share one Google connection. Connect once in Google Sheets to use both, with the option to bring your own OAuth client if needed.

auth.label: Google (Connect Google)
auth.hint: Connect your own Google OAuth application in OrgSDK. The host refreshes tokens; plugins receive only a run-scoped access token.

setupGuide.summary: Connect your own Google OAuth application in OrgSDK. The host manages consent and token refresh. Plugins receive only a fresh access token; the former first-party relay is unsupported.
prerequisites: Access to create or edit a Google Cloud project.
Permission to configure the project's OAuth consent screen and credentials.
A Google account that can authorize the requested workspace data.

steps.title: Open or create a Google Cloud project
steps.description: Use an existing project or create a new one to hold the OAuth client. This single connection covers both Sheets and Tasks.

steps.title: Enable the required APIs
steps.description: The shared connection needs both the Google Sheets API and the Google Tasks API, because Google Tasks reuses this connection.

steps.title: Configure the OAuth consent screen
steps.description: Set the consent screen to External (or Internal for Workspace). Add your own Google account as a test user while the app remains in testing.

steps.title: Create a Web application OAuth client
steps.description: Create credentials of type OAuth client ID. The application type must be Web application — not Desktop app or another type.

steps.title: Add the authorized redirect URI
steps.description: Register the exact redirect URI shown by OrgSDK: your registered workspace origin followed by /oauth/callback. Add it under Authorized redirect URIs, not JavaScript origins.

steps.title: Download the OAuth client JSON
steps.description: Download the OAuth client configuration, then enter its client ID and client secret in OrgSDK’s native Connect form. Keep these secrets on the host; do not put them in plugin configuration.

steps.title: Connect Google
steps.description: Saving valid JSON enables the authorization action. Complete Google's consent screen — Google Tasks is covered by this same connection.

callback.label: Authorized redirect URI
callback.instruction: Paste this exact URL into the OAuth client's Authorized redirect URIs list.

configField.label: Google OAuth client JSON
configField.description: Paste the complete contents of the JSON file downloaded for the Web application OAuth client. It contains a client ID and client secret.

Generate weekly reports by appending agent run results
Update specific rows in a table from workflow output
Read a sheet as a config or lookup source for an agent
marketplace.permissionsSummary: Access Google Sheets and Tasks data via OAuth.

seoOverview.heading: Integrate AI agents with Google Sheets
seoOverview.paragraph: Connect Google Sheets to an OrgSDK agent team and give workflows direct read and write access to your spreadsheets. Agents can read a range as a lookup or config source, append rows from workflow output, and update individual columns inside a structured table — running on a schedule or on demand, with an approval gate before any write. The plugin supports both A1 ranges and Google's structured table format, so existing sheets work without migration.
